roadmap.title: Mabutts Valley
roadmap.description: Drive Mabutts Valley to the credits, taking each tape, cosmetic, and hidden event on the way.

roadmap.title: Mt. Yurbuttsk
roadmap.description: Cross the snow map, finishing the snowball, ice, and nitroglycerin tasks and its tapes and cosmetics.

roadmap.title: St. Búttin Bay
roadmap.description: Cross the island map, picking up its tapes, moped stunts, and hidden events.

roadmap.title: Golf Heaven
roadmap.description: Finish the golf challenges and the last cosmetic at the end of the golf map.

roadmap.title: Cumulative counters
roadmap.description: Finish the long-running counters that build up across all maps.

steps.text: Die 25 times. Deaths from any map count toward the total.
Use an @item{Epipen} 20 times. Uses on every map count toward the total.
Restart from a checkpoint to repeat faster.
Use @item{scrap} 100 times. Uses on every map count toward the total.
Restart from a checkpoint to repeat faster.
Throw @item{Nitroglycerin} so that it explodes, 15 times.
Restart from a checkpoint to repeat faster.
Drink @item{beer} 100 times.
Restart from a checkpoint to repeat faster.
Smoke @item{cigarettes} until you reach 512.
Press the 1 and 3 keys repeatedly, or set up a macro for them, to go faster.
Connect @item{planks} 50 times. Connections on every map count.
On @loc{Mt. Yurbuttsk}, farm this by reloading Checkpoint 1 or Checkpoint 2.

achievements.description: Drive the RV 1km with a single turbo fuel
achievements.summary: Drive the RV 1 km on a single turbo fuel.

steps.text: Get a @item{turbo fuel}. It is available from @loc{Checkpoint 11} on @loc{Mt. Yurbuttsk} onward.
Use that one turbo fuel and drive the RV 1 km.

achievements.description: Reel in 1km of rope with the winch
achievements.summary: Pull in a total of 1 km of rope with the winch.

steps.text: Use the @item{winch} to reel in rope until the total reaches 1 km. Reeling on every map counts, and progress is saved.
Find the @enemy{moose} that drop just before the @loc{Checkpoint 3} gas station.
Throw a moose onto the grill.

achievements.summary: Step onto a mine, then walk off without setting the mine off.

steps.text: Go to the mines between @loc{Checkpoint 3} and @loc{Checkpoint 4}. The first mine is on the right path at the fork after the ferry and the climb.
Stand on the mine until you hear a click.
Walk off the mine very slowly so that it does not explode.

achievements.description: Set off 5 mines without taking damage
achievements.summary: Detonate 5 mines and take no damage.

steps.text: Go to the mines at @loc{Checkpoint 3}. More mines are near @loc{Checkpoint 14}.
From far away, throw a big object such as a plank or a grill onto each mine so that it explodes without hurting you.
Restart from Checkpoint 3 to retry faster.

achievements.summary: Destroy the helicopter in Mabutts Valley.

steps.text: Ram the RV into the red pillar so the helicopter starts leaking fuel.
Drop a cigarette into the leaking fuel.

achievements.description: Bring Austin's skeleton with you when you finish the game.
achievements.summary: Finish Mabutts Valley with Austin's skeleton still with you.

guide.context: This is easier with several players.

steps.text: At @loc{Checkpoint 15}, take Austin's skeleton from inside the house.
Put him on top of the RV, where the winches normally go, so he cannot fall off or vanish if you die.
Keep him there until the credits roll.

steps.text: Finish the map after @loc{Checkpoint 16} so that the credits roll.
Use @item{snow chains} 10 times on @loc{Mt. Yurbuttsk}.
Restart from a checkpoint to repeat faster.
Break out of an ice cube 4 times in total.
You can work on this while earning the snowball headshots.

achievements.description: Travel 500m with the tractor tube in one sitting
achievements.summary: Travel 500 m on the tractor tube in one sitting.

steps.text: Ride the @item{tractor tube} for 500 m without getting off. The very first hill on the map is enough.

achievements.description: Scare a snow leopard with snowball
achievements.summary: Scare a snow leopard by hitting it with a snowball.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{snow leopard} on @loc{Mt. Yurbuttsk}.
Throw a snowball at it.

achievements.description: Headshot friends with a snowball 10 times
achievements.summary: Hit friends in the head with snowballs 10 times.

steps.text: Throw snowballs at your friends' heads until you have scored 10 headshots. Another player is needed.
Reach @loc{Checkpoint 13} on @loc{Mt. Yurbuttsk}.
Right after @loc{Checkpoint 13}, throw @item{Nitroglycerin} directly in front of the @enemy{ice monster}.
Drive to @loc{Checkpoint 1} on @loc{Mt. Yurbuttsk}.
Drive to @loc{Checkpoint 2} on @loc{Mt. Yurbuttsk}.
Drive to @loc{Checkpoint 3} on @loc{Mt. Yurbuttsk}.

achievements.summary: Give another player to a Ronki.

steps.text: Between @loc{Checkpoint 5} and @loc{Checkpoint 6}, let a @enemy{Ronki} take another player.

achievements.description: Have K2 make you a Coconut Drink
achievements.summary: Get a Coconut Drink made for you by K2.

steps.text: Near @loc{Checkpoint 0}, give the @npc{K2 Bar Man} a coconut.
Between @loc{Checkpoint 3} and @loc{Checkpoint 4}, go to the shark lake.
Harpoon a shark onto land. The boat counts as land.
At @loc{Checkpoint 9}, winch the RV down between two trees so it cannot fly away.
Use a @item{harpoon gun} to pop balloons until 25 are gone.

achievements.summary: Get 7 skips with a thrown rock.

steps.text: In @loc{Golf Heaven}, ride the golf cart to the far end of the driving range, where the beach is.
Pick up a skipping stone, get level with the water, and throw it at max power. Keep trying until it skips 7 times.

achievements.description: Enter the six numbers from the title into the bunker computer.
achievements.summary: Type the six numbers 4, 8, 15, 16, 23 and 42 into the bunker computer.

steps.text: Before @loc{Checkpoint 16}, take the left path.
Go down the ladder into the bunker.
Type 4,8,15,16,23,42 on the computer.

achievements.description: Achieve 20 volleys with a beach paddle

steps.text: At @loc{Checkpoint 0}, use the beach paddle to hit items back and forth for 20 volleys. The paddle can hit any item.

achievements.description: Complete a lap in the traffic jam
achievements.summary: Finish one full lap of the traffic jam.

steps.text: At @loc{Checkpoint 13}, drive in the leftmost lane or on the shoulder. Traffic stops when you are in a lane.
Move back onto the road only when something blocks your way, and finish the lap.

achievements.description: Reach the peak of Moped Mountain
achievements.summary: Reach the peak of Moped Mountain.

steps.text: At @loc{Checkpoint 7}, ride a moped up @loc{Moped Mountain} to the top.

achievements.description: Do a double backflip on a moped
achievements.summary: Land two backflips in one jump on a moped.

steps.text: At @loc{Checkpoint 7}, ride a moped and do two backflips in one jump. You can do this during the Moped Mountain climb.

achievements.description: Finish a round of golf 9 under par.
achievements.summary: Finish a round of Golf Heaven 9 under par.

steps.text: Play a full round and score one under par on each hole. If you miss a birdie, make it up with an eagle on a later hole.
Tee off, knock the ball close to the hole with beer cans, then putt.
Play in @loc{Golf Heaven} and sink a tee shot straight into the hole.
Putt from 20 meters away and sink the ball.
Remove the flag pole from the hole if you want a clearer shot.
Start a golf match in @loc{Golf Heaven}. The balls must be hit during a match.
Hit balls into the water at max power until 50 have drowned.

achievements.description: Roll credits in St. Búttin Bay
achievements.summary: Roll the credits in St. Búttin Bay.

steps.text: Finish the map after @loc{Checkpoint 22} so that the credits roll.
Start a round and use the driver on a tee, such as hole 1 toward the driving range or hole 3.
Swing with full power and aim high on the ball when the mini game appears, which adds top spin. Try again until the ball flies 300 meters.
Enter a golf tournament in @loc{Golf Heaven} and finish in first place.
